title: Colorblind Glasses
description: This data pack adds colorblindness to the game.
body:
# Colorblind Glasses

This data pack adds Protanopia and Tritanopia glasses. Wearing the Protanopia glasses causes the wearer to become red-green colorblind. While the Tritanopia glasses cause the wearer to become blue-yellow colorblind.

** This data pack has a required resource pack.**

 ⚠Attention: Due to Minecraft's limited shader customization set your graphics setting to _Fabulous!_ Or else the resource pack won't work!
